channel.title: 我嘅每日話題
channel.description: 每日精選時事、商業、股市、宇宙、科技話題

item.title: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
item.description: Arabica coffee prices hit a record level, as traders digested the withdrawal of President Trump’s threats to impose tariffs and economic sanctions on Colombia.

item.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
item.description: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

item.title: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
item.description: Panic fueling the selloff of Nvidia, Broadcom and other tech giants is overblown.

item.title: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
item.description: Gold settled 1.4% lower, down two of the past three sessions, and silver fell 2.5%, down three of the past four sessions.

item.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
item.description: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

item.description: SpaceX announced a new version of its all-in-one satellite internet terminal that integrates a dish, Wi-Fi router, and now a battery into a single device about the size of a laptop. item.description: Sony has canceled Fairgames, a heist game announced in 2023, according to Bloomberg. item.description: Oura announced its quarterly earnings today and said it agreed to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million, after adding the company's AI chatbot to its app earlier this year. Counsel Health calls itself an "AI-native primary care company," using the app to deliver AI-generated responses and insights

item.description: Disney is bringing more than 60 3D movies to the Disney Plus app on Meta Quest. The movies will be available to Disney Plus subscribers as part of an updated Disney Plus app that's rolling out today. item.title: Microsoft’s DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode
item.description: Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today. Auto SR is also getting some new features alongside this official release

item.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
item.description: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

item.title: Apple TV makes sign language interpretation a built-in accessibility feature
item.description: Apple TV's new accessibility feature lets viewers turn on sign language interpretation within supported titles.

item.title: Sundrop turns your endless baby photos into recaps, time lapses, and more — without AI
item.description: Sundrop is a new iPhone app that uses Apple's on-device AI to help parents rediscover their favorite photos and create keepsakes without uploading images to the cloud.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
item.description: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
item.description: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

item.title: Pixel Tag, Google’s $30 Android-ready answer to Apple’s AirTag, is now available
item.description: Google's Pixel Tag lets you track lost items with your Android device, similar to Apple's AirTag.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
item.description: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

item.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
item.description: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

item.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
item.description: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

item.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
item.description: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

item.title: X-energy gets green light to build its first small modular nuclear reactors
item.description: X-energy received a construction permit from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission to build four reactors in Texas.

item.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
item.description: Former SignalFire investor Sahir Raoof raises $27.5 million for new fund targeting AI in pharma.

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
item.description: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

item.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
item.description: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

item.title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement
item.description: X is jumping into clipping, the popular practice of cutting long videos into short, shareable clips that can go viral.
